children: Zurich Insurance Group said Alex Wells will join the group executive committee, following his recent appointment as CEO of the company's U.S. business.
The Swiss insurer said on Tuesday that its board appointed Wells to the committee, effective immediately.
The appointment follows the selection of Wells to be the CEO of Zurich U.S. on Sept. 11.
